units.zh: 與敵國互市之所也。
units.en: These were the designated sites for border trade with hostile states.
units.literal: They are the places for mutual trade with enemy states.

units.zh: 皆設場官，嚴厲禁，廣屋宇以通二國之貨，歲之所獲亦大有助於經用焉。
units.en: Each market had its own superintendent, strict regulations, and ample warehouses to move goods between the two realms, and annual receipts substantially eased the state's budget.
units.literal: At each one market officials were set up, prohibitions strictly enforced, and buildings expanded to circulate the goods of the two states; what was gained each year also greatly assisted state expenditures.

units.zh: 熙宗皇統二年五月，許宋人之請，遂各置於兩界。
units.en: In the fifth month of Xizong's Huangtong 2 (1142), the court granted the Song petition and set up markets on both sides of the frontier.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Huangtong 2 under Emperor Xizong, the Song people's request was granted, and each side then established them on both borders.

units.zh: 九月，命壽州、鄧州、鳳翔府等處皆置。
units.en: In the ninth month the court ordered markets established at Shouzhou, Dengzhou, Fengxiang Prefecture, and other points.
units.literal: In the ninth month orders were issued to establish them at Shouzhou, Dengzhou, Fengxiang Prefecture, and other places.

units.zh: 海陵正隆四年正月，罷鳳翔府、唐、鄧、潁、蔡、鞏、洮等州並膠西縣所置者，而專置於泗州。
units.en: In the first month of Hailing's Zhenglong 4 (1159), the court closed the markets at Fengxiang Prefecture and at Tang, Deng, Ying, Cai, Gong, Tao, and other prefectures, as well as Jiaoxi County, concentrating border trade at Sizhou alone.
units.literal: In the first month of Zhenglong 4 under Prince Hailing, those established at Fengxiang Prefecture and the prefectures of Tang, Deng, Ying, Cai, Gong, and Tao, as well as Jiaoxi County, were abolished, and markets were set up only at Sizhou.

units.zh: 尋伐宋，亦罷之。
units.en: When war against the Song broke out soon after, those markets were closed as well.
units.literal: Soon afterward, when campaigning against the Song, these too were abolished.

units.zh: 五年八月，命榷場起赴南京。
units.en: In the eighth month of year 5 the court ordered the border markets relocated to the Southern Capital.
units.literal: In the eighth month of year 5 orders were issued for the monopoly markets to be moved to the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 國初于西北招討司之燕子城、北羊城之間嘗置之，以易北方牧畜。
units.en: Early in the dynasty a market had stood between Swallow City and North Sheep City under the Northwestern Pacification Commission, where Jin goods were traded for livestock from the northern steppe.
units.literal: At the beginning of the dynasty they had once been placed between Swallow City and North Sheep City under the Northwestern Pacification Commission, to exchange for northern pastoral livestock.

units.zh: 世宗大定三年，市馬于夏國之榷場。
units.en: In Shizong's Dading 3 (1163) the court bought horses at the Western Xia border market.
units.literal: In the third year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, horses were purchased at the Western Xia monopoly market.

units.zh: 四年，以尚書省奏，複置泗、壽、蔡、唐、鄧、潁、密、鳳翔、秦、鞏、洮諸場。
units.en: In the fourth year, acting on a memorial from the Department of State Affairs, the court reopened markets at Si, Shou, Cai, Tang, Deng, Ying, Mi, Fengxiang, Qin, Gong, and Tao.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on a memorial from the Department of State Affairs, the markets at Si, Shou, Cai, Tang, Deng, Ying, Mi, Fengxiang, Qin, Gong, and Tao were all re-established.

units.zh: 七年，禁秦州場不得賣米麵、及羊豕之臘、並可作軍器之物入外界。
units.en: In the seventh year the Qinzhou market was barred from exporting rice, flour, cured meats, or any material that could be turned into weapons.
units.literal: In the seventh year it was forbidden for the Qinzhou market to sell rice and flour, cured pork and mutton, or any goods that could be made into weapons to the outer realm.

units.zh: 十七年二月，上謂宰臣曰：「宋人喜生事背盟，或與大石交通，恐枉害生靈，不可不備。
units.en: In the second month of year seventeen the emperor told his ministers, "The Song delight in provocation and treaty-breaking and may even deal with the Kara-Khitai. Innocent lives could be lost if we are caught unprepared.
units.literal: In the second month of the seventeenth year the emperor told his ministers: "The Song are fond of stirring trouble and breaking treaties; they may also communicate with the Kara-Khitai. I fear innocent lives will be harmed in vain—we cannot fail to prepare.

units.zh: 其陝西沿邊榷場可止留一處，餘悉罷之。
units.en: Along the Shaanxi frontier only one border market should remain; all others are to be closed.
units.literal: Of the monopoly markets along the Shaanxi border, only one may be retained; the rest are all to be abolished.

units.zh: 令所司嚴察奸細。」
units.en: Responsible offices were ordered to tighten scrutiny of spies and infiltrators."
units.literal: Let the responsible offices strictly investigate spies."

units.zh: 前此，以防奸細，罷西界蘭州、保安、綏德三榷場。
units.en: Earlier, to block spies, the court had already closed the three western markets at Lanzhou, Bao'an, and Suide.
units.literal: Earlier, to guard against spies, the three monopoly markets at Lanzhou, Bao'an, and Suide on the western frontier had been abolished.

units.zh: 二十一年正月，夏國王李仁孝上表乞複置，以保安、蘭州無所產，而且稅少，惟於綏德為要地，可複設互市，命省臣議之。
units.en: In the first month of year twenty-one Western Xia's King Li Renxiao petitioned for restoration, noting that Bao'an and Lanzhou yielded little produce and scant revenue, whereas Suide was a strategic site where border trade should resume; the court referred the matter to provincial ministers.
units.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year Western Xia King Li Renxiao submitted a memorial begging restoration, saying Bao'an and Lanzhou produced nothing and their tax receipts were slight, but Suide was a vital place where mutual trade could be re-established; provincial ministers were ordered to deliberate.

units.zh: 宰臣以陝西鄰西夏，邊民私越境盜竊，緣有榷場，故奸人得往來，擬東勝可依舊設，陝西者並罷之。
units.en: The chief ministers argued that with Western Xia on Shaanxi's border, frontier residents crossed illegally to steal, and open markets let agents move freely; they proposed keeping Dongsheng as before while closing every Shaanxi market.
units.literal: The chief ministers held that Shaanxi bordered Western Xia, border people privately crossed to steal, and because monopoly markets existed traitors could come and go; they proposed that Dongsheng could be kept as before while all Shaanxi markets be abolished.

units.zh: 上曰：「東勝與陝西道路隔絕，貿易不通，其令環州置一場。」
units.en: The emperor replied, "Dongsheng and Shaanxi are too far apart for trade to flow; establish a market at Huanzhou instead."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Dongsheng and Shaanxi are cut off by roads and trade cannot pass; let a market be established at Huanzhou."

units.zh: 尋於綏德州複置一場。
units.en: A market at Suide Prefecture was reopened soon afterward.
units.literal: Soon afterward one market was re-established at Suide Prefecture.

units.zh: 十二月，禁壽州榷場受分例。
units.en: In the twelfth month the court forbade the Shouzhou market from accepting kickback payments.
units.literal: In the twelfth month it was forbidden for the Shouzhou monopoly market to accept fenli.

units.zh: 分例者，商人贄見場官之錢幣也。
units.en: Fenli were gratuities merchants paid market officials on presentation.
units.literal: Fenli were the cash merchants presented as gifts when meeting market officials.

units.zh: 章宗明昌二年七月，尚書省以泗州榷場自前關防不嚴，遂奏定從大定五年制，官為增修舍屋，倍設闌禁，委場官及提控所拘榷，以提刑司舉察。
units.en: In the seventh month of Zhangzong's Mingchang 2 (1191) the Department of State Affairs noted lax controls at the Sizhou market and proposed adopting the Dading 5 rules: state-funded repairs, doubled checkpoints, supervision by market officials and control offices, and inspection by the surveillance commission.
units.literal: In the seventh month of Mingchang 2 under Emperor Zhangzong, the Department of State Affairs reported that from earlier times border controls at the Sizhou monopoly market had not been strict, and memorialized to fix regulations following the Dading 5 system: officials were to enlarge and repair buildings, double the barriers, entrust market officials and control offices with monopoly supervision, and have the surveillance commission investigate.

units.zh: 惟東勝、淨、慶州，來遠軍者仍舊，余皆修完之。
units.en: Only Dongsheng, Jing, Qingzhou, and Laiyuan Army were left unchanged; all other sites were refurbished.
units.literal: Only Dongsheng, Jing, Qingzhou, and Laiyuan Army were left as before; the rest were all repaired and completed.

units.zh: 泗州場，大定間，歲獲五萬三千四百六十七貫，承安元年，增為十萬七千八百九十三貫六百五十三文。
units.en: During the Dading era the Sizhou market yielded 53,467 strings annually; in Cheng'an 1 (1196) receipts rose to 107,893 strings and 653 cash.
units.literal: The Sizhou market during the Dading period yielded 53,467 strings per year; in the first year of Cheng'an it rose to 107,893 strings 653 cash.

units.zh: 所須雜物，泗州場歲供進新茶千胯、荔支五百斤、圓眼五百斤、金橘六千斤、橄欖五百斤、芭蕉幹三百個、蘇木千斤、溫柑七千個、橘子八千個、沙糖三百斤、生薑六百斤、梔子九十稱、犀象丹砂之類不與焉。
units.en: Each year the Sizhou market also forwarded tribute goods: 1,000 bundles of fresh tea, 500 jin of lychee, 500 jin of longan, 6,000 jin of kumquat, 500 jin of olives, 300 dried plantains, 1,000 jin of sappanwood, 7,000 Wenzhou oranges, 8,000 oranges, 300 jin of sugar, 600 jin of ginger, and 90 sheng of gardenia—excluding rhinoceros horn, ivory, cinnabar, and similar luxuries.
units.literal: Among required miscellaneous goods, the Sizhou market each year presented as tribute 1,000 bundles of new tea, 500 jin of lychee, 500 jin of longan, 6,000 jin of kumquat, 500 jin of olive, 300 dried plantains, 1,000 jin of sappanwood, 7,000 Wenzhou oranges, 8,000 oranges, 300 jin of sugar, 600 jin of ginger, and 90 sheng of gardenia—not including rhinoceros horn, ivory, cinnabar, and the like.

units.zh: 宋亦歲得課四萬三千貫。
units.en: The Song likewise collected 43,000 strings in annual duties.
units.literal: The Song also gained 43,000 strings in revenue each year.

units.zh: 秦州西子城場，大定間，歲獲三萬三千六百五十六貫，承安元年，歲獲十二萬二千九十九貫。
units.en: During Dading the Qinzhou Xizi City market yielded 33,656 strings a year; in Cheng'an 1 receipts reached 122,099 strings.
units.literal: The Qinzhou Xizi City market during Dading yielded 33,656 strings per year; in Cheng'an 1 it yielded 122,099 strings per year.

units.zh: 承安二年，複置於保安、蘭州。
units.en: In Cheng'an 2 (1197) markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou were reopened.
units.literal: In Cheng'an 2 they were re-established at Bao'an and Lanzhou.

units.zh: 三年九月，行樞密院奏：「斜出等告開榷場，擬於轄裏尼要安置。」
units.en: In the ninth month of year three the Mobile Privy Council reported, "Xiechu and others have requested the opening of a border market; we propose placing it at a strategic point in Xialini."
units.literal: In the ninth month of year three the Mobile Privy Council reported, "Xiechu and others have requested the opening of a border market; we propose placing it at a strategic point in Xialini."

units.zh: 許自今年十一月貿易。
units.en: Trade was authorized beginning in the eleventh month of that year.
units.literal: Permission was granted for trade from the eleventh month of this year.

units.zh: 尋定制，隨路榷場若以見錢入外界、與外人交易者，徒五年，三斤以上死。
units.en: Regulations soon fixed that taking cash across the border or trading it with foreigners at any circuit market drew five years' penal servitude, and three jin or more meant death.
units.literal: Soon regulations were fixed: at monopoly markets in each circuit, if cash coin was taken into the outer realm or traded with foreigners, penal servitude for five years; three jin or more meant death.

units.zh: 宋界諸場，以伐宋皆罷。
units.en: Every market on the Song frontier was closed when war against the Song resumed.
units.literal: All markets on the Song border were abolished because of the campaign against the Song.

units.zh: 泰和八年八月，以與宋和，宋人請如舊置之，遂複置於唐、鄧、壽、泗、息州及秦、鳳之地。
units.en: In the eighth month of Taihe 8 (1208), after peace with the Song and a Song request to restore the old arrangement, markets reopened at Tang, Deng, Shou, Si, Xizhou, and in the Qin and Feng regions.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Taihe 8, because peace was made with the Song and the Song requested restoration as before, markets were re-established at Tang, Deng, Shou, Si, Xizhou, and in the Qin and Feng regions.

units.zh: 宣宗貞祐元年，秦州榷場為宋人所焚。
units.en: In Xuanzong's Zhenyou 1 (1213), the Qinzhou market was burned by Song forces.
units.literal: In Xuanzong's Zhenyou 1 (1213), the Qinzhou market was burned by Song forces.

units.zh: 二年，陝西安撫副使烏古論袞州複開設之，歲所獲以十數萬計。
units.en: In year two, Shaanxi Deputy Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Gunzhou reopened it, and annual receipts were counted in the hundreds of thousands.
units.literal: In year two, Shaanxi Deputy Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Gunzhou reopened it, and annual receipts were counted in the hundreds of thousands.

units.zh: 三年七月，議欲聽榷場互市用銀，而計數稅之。
units.en: In the seventh month of year three, officials discussed allowing silver to be used in mutual trade at the border markets and taxing it by amount.
units.literal: In the seventh month of year three, officials discussed allowing silver to be used in mutual trade at the border markets and taxing it by amount.

units.zh: 上曰：「如此，是公使銀入外界也。」
units.en: The emperor said, "If we do this, it is openly sending silver across the border."
units.literal: The emperor said, "If we do this, it is openly sending silver across the border."

units.zh: 平章盡忠、權參知政事德升曰：「賞賜之用莫如銀絹，而府庫不足以給之。
units.en: Chief Minister Jinzhong and Acting Vice Director of the Secretariat Desheng said, "For rewards and grants nothing is better than silver and silk, but the treasury cannot supply enough.
units.literal: Chief Minister Jinzhong and Acting Vice Director of the Secretariat Desheng said, "For rewards and grants nothing is better than silver and silk, but the treasury cannot supply enough.

units.zh: 互市雖有禁，而私易者自如。
units.en: Although mutual trade is forbidden, private traders do as they please.
units.literal: Although mutual trade is forbidden, private traders do as they please.

units.zh: 若稅之，則斂不及民而用可足。」
units.en: If it is taxed, the levy will not reach the common people, and state needs can be met."
units.literal: If it is taxed, the levy will not reach the common people, and state needs can be met."

units.zh: 平章高琪曰：「小人敢犯，法不行爾，況許之乎？
units.en: Chief Minister Gao Qi said, "Petty people dare to violate the law only because the law is not enforced. How much worse if we permit it?
units.literal: Chief Minister Gao Qi said, "Petty people dare to violate the law only because the law is not enforced. How much worse if we permit it?

units.zh: 今軍未息，而產銀之地皆在外界，不禁則公私指日罄矣！」
units.en: Now the armies have not yet stood down, and all the silver-producing lands are outside our borders. If this is not banned, public and private silver will soon be exhausted!"
units.literal: Now the armies have not yet stood down, and all the silver-producing lands are outside our borders. If this is not banned, public and private silver will soon be exhausted!"

units.zh: 上曰：「當熟計之。」
units.en: The emperor said, "This should be carefully considered."
units.literal: The emperor said, "This should be carefully considered."

units.zh: 興定元年，集賢諮議官呂鑒言：「嘗監息州榷場，每場獲布數千匹，銀數百兩，兵興之後皆失之。」
units.en: In Xingding 1 (1217), Jixian Advisory Official Lu Jian said, "I once supervised the Xizhou market. Each market obtained several thousand bolts of cloth and several hundred taels of silver, but after the fighting began, all of this was lost."
units.literal: In Xingding 1 (1217), Jixian Advisory Official Lu Jian said, "I once supervised the Xizhou market. Each market obtained several thousand bolts of cloth and several hundred taels of silver, but after the fighting began, all of this was lost."

units.zh: 金銀之稅。
units.en: Tax on Gold and Silver
units.literal: Tax on gold and silver.

units.zh: 世宗大定五年，聽人射買寶山縣銀冶。
units.en: In Shizong's Dading 5 (1165) the court allowed competitive bidding for the Baoshan County silver works.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, people were permitted to bid competitively for the Baoshan County silver smeltery.

units.zh: 九年，御史台奏河南府以和買金銀，抑配百姓，且下其直。
units.en: In the ninth year the Censorate reported that Henan Prefecture had used state gold-and-silver purchases to coerce the populace and cut payment below fair value.
units.literal: In the ninth year the Censorate memorialized that Henan Prefecture used harmonized purchase of gold and silver, forcibly apportioned it among the people, and also lowered the price.

units.zh: 上曰：「初，朕欲泉貨流通，故令行，豈可反害民乎？」
units.en: The emperor said, "I ordered this to keep currency circulating. How can it end up harming the people instead?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "At first I wished currency to circulate, and therefore ordered this carried out—how can it instead harm the people?"

units.zh: 遂罷之。
units.en: The practice was abolished.
units.literal: It was therefore abolished.

units.zh: 十二年，詔金銀坑冶，恣民采，毋收稅。
units.en: In the twelfth year an edict allowed free private mining of gold and silver without tax.
units.literal: In the twelfth year an edict declared that gold and silver mines and smelters might be freely mined by the people without collecting tax.

units.zh: 二十七年，尚書省奏：「聽民于農隙采銀，承納官課。」
units.en: In year twenty-seven the Department of State Affairs memorialized, "Let the people mine silver in agricultural slack seasons and pay the official dues."
units.literal: In year twenty-seven the Department of State Affairs memorialized, "Let the people mine silver in agricultural slack seasons and pay the official dues."

units.zh: 明昌二年，天下見在金千二百餘鋌，銀五十五萬二千餘鋌。
units.en: By Mingchang 2 (1191) circulating gold exceeded 1,200 ingots and silver more than 552,000 ingots empire-wide.
units.literal: In Mingchang 2, gold in circulation throughout the realm exceeded 1,200 ingots and silver 552,000-odd ingots.

units.zh: 三年，以提刑司言，封諸處銀冶，禁民采煉。
units.en: In the third year, on the surveillance commission's advice, silver works were sealed nationwide and private mining forbidden.
units.literal: In the third year, on a report from the surveillance commission, silver smelteries everywhere were sealed and private mining and smelting forbidden.

units.zh: 五年，以御史台奏，請令民采煉隨處金銀銅冶，上命尚書省議之。
units.en: In the fifth year the Censorate asked to reopen local gold, silver, and copper works to private operators; the emperor referred the matter to the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: In the fifth year, on a Censorate memorial requesting that the people be allowed to mine and smelt gold, silver, and copper works wherever located, the emperor ordered the Department of State Affairs to deliberate.

units.zh: 宰臣議謂：「國家承平日久，戶口增息，雖嘗禁之，而貧人苟求生計，聚眾私煉。
units.en: The chief ministers argued, "The state has enjoyed long peace and the population has grown; although mining has been forbidden, poor people seeking a livelihood gather in groups to smelt in secret.
units.literal: The chief ministers argued, "The state has enjoyed long peace and the population has grown; although mining has been forbidden, poor people seeking a livelihood gather in groups to smelt in secret.

units.zh: 上有禁之之名。
units.en: Prohibition existed in name only.
units.literal: Above there is the name of prohibition.

units.zh: 而無杜絕之實，故官無利而民多犯法。
units.en: Yet smuggling continued unchecked, so the state gained nothing while commoners broke the law in droves.
units.literal: Yet there is no reality of cutting it off; therefore the government gains no profit while the people frequently break the law.

units.zh: 如令民射買，則貧民壯者為夫匠，老稚供雜役，各得均齊，而射買之家亦有餘利。
units.en: Competitive bidding would let poor households deploy strong men as master smiths and elders and children as helpers, share work fairly, and still leave contractors a margin.
units.literal: If the people are allowed competitive bidding, then among the poor the strong become master craftsmen, the old and young supply miscellaneous labor, each receives fair shares, and the bidding households also have surplus profit.

units.zh: 如此，則可以久行。
units.en: Such a system could be sustained long term.
units.literal: Thus it can be carried on for long.

units.zh: 比之官役顧工，糜費百端者，有間矣。」
units.en: Compared with state-run operations that hire labor and waste resources in countless ways, there is a clear difference."
units.literal: Compared with state-run operations that hire labor and waste resources in countless ways, there is a clear difference."

units.zh: 遂定制，有冶之地，委謀克縣令籍數，召募射買。
units.en: Regulations followed: wherever mines existed, mouke and county magistrates were to register sites and invite competitive bids.
units.literal: Regulations were then fixed: wherever smelteries existed, mouke and county magistrates were entrusted to register numbers and summon competitive bids.

units.zh: 禁權要、官吏、弓兵、裏胥皆不得與。
units.en: Powerful families, officials, bow soldiers, and village clerks were barred from taking contracts.
units.literal: It was forbidden for powerful families, officials, bow soldiers, and village clerks to participate.

units.zh: 如舊場之例，令州府長官一員提控，提刑司訪察而禁治之。
units.en: As with the old market system, one prefectural chief supervised each site while the surveillance commission investigated abuses.
units.literal: Following the example of old markets, one prefectural chief was appointed to supervise, and the surveillance commission was to investigate and prohibit abuses.

units.zh: 上曰：「此終非長策。」
units.en: The emperor said, "This is no lasting solution."
units.literal: The emperor said: "This is ultimately not a long-term policy."

units.zh: 參知政事胥持國曰：「今姑聽如此，後有利然後設官可也。
units.en: Vice Director Xu Chiguo replied, "Let it stand for now; once revenues justify it, the state can appoint officials.
units.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat Xu Chiguo said: "For now let it be heard thus; when there is profit afterward, officials may then be established.

units.zh: 譬之酒酤，蓋先為坊場，從後官榷也。」
units.en: It resembles the wine trade: private workshops come first, state monopoly later."
units.literal: It is like wine sales—first establish workshops and markets, and afterward the state monopolizes."

units.zh: 上亦以為然，遂從之。
units.en: The emperor agreed, and the proposal was adopted.
units.literal: The emperor also held this correct and followed it.

units.zh: 墳山、西銀山之銀窟凡百一十有三。
units.en: Fen Mountain and West Silver Mountain together held 113 silver mines.
units.literal: Silver mines at Fen Mountain and West Silver Mountain numbered 113 in all.

units.zh: 熙宗皇統二年十月，燕、西、東京、河東、河北、山東，汴京等路秋熟，命有司增價和糴。
units.en: In the tenth month of Xizong's Huangtong 2 (1142), after the harvest in Yan, Western, Eastern Capital, Hedong, Hebei, Shandong, and Bianjing circuits, officials were ordered to buy grain at premium prices.
units.literal: In the tenth month of Huangtong 2 under Emperor Xizong, when autumn crops ripened in the Yan, Western, Eastern Capital, Hedong, Hebei, Shandong, and Bianjing circuits, responsible offices were ordered to raise prices for harmonized grain purchase.

units.zh: 世宗大定二年，以正隆之後倉廩久匱，遣太子少師完顏守道等，山東東、西路收糴軍糧，除戶口歲食外，盡令納官，給其直。
units.en: In Shizong's Dading 2 (1162), with granaries depleted since the Zhenglong era, Junior Tutor Wanyan Shoudao was sent to eastern and western Shandong to buy army grain, requiring households to sell all surplus beyond annual rations at fair price.
units.literal: In the second year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, because after Zhenglong the granaries had long been empty, Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Wanyan Shoudao and others were sent to the eastern and western Shandong circuits to purchase army grain; apart from each household's yearly food, all was ordered surrendered to the government and paid for.

units.zh: 三年，謂宰臣曰：「國家經費甚大，向令山東和糴，止得四十五萬余石，未足為備。
units.en: In the third year he told his ministers, "State expenses are enormous. The last Shandong purchase brought only 450,000-odd shi—not enough for reserves.
units.literal: In the third year he told his ministers: "State expenditures are very great; the earlier order for Shandong harmonized purchase yielded only 450,000-odd shi—not enough as reserve.

units.zh: 自古有水旱，所以無患者，由蓄積多也。
units.en: Floods and droughts are as old as history; states escaped harm only when granaries were full.
units.literal: From antiquity there have been flood and drought; the reason there was no harm was because accumulations were abundant.

units.zh: 山東軍屯處須急為二年之儲，若遇水旱則用賑濟。
units.en: Shandong garrison districts need two years' grain on hand at once for relief when disaster strikes.
units.literal: Where army colonies stood in Shandong, a two-year reserve must urgently be made; if flood or drought occurs, use it for relief.

units.zh: 自餘宿兵之郡，亦須糴以足之。
units.en: Other provinces hosting troops must buy grain until stores are full.
units.literal: The remaining prefectures where troops are stationed must also purchase grain to fill them.

units.zh: 京師之用甚大，所須之儲，其敕戶部宜急為計。」
units.en: The capital's needs are vast; the Revenue Ministry must plan reserves without delay."
units.literal: The capital's consumption is very great; as for the required reserves, the Revenue Ministry should urgently devise plans."

units.zh: 五年，責宰臣曰：「朕謂積貯為國本，當修倉廩以廣和糴。
units.en: In the fifth year he rebuked his ministers: "Stored grain is the state's foundation. Repair granaries and expand government purchases.
units.literal: In the fifth year he reproached his ministers: "I hold that stored grain is the foundation of the state; granaries should be repaired to expand harmonized purchase.

units.zh: 今聞外路官文具而已。
units.en: I hear outer-circuit officials treat this as paperwork only.
units.literal: Now I hear that officials on outer circuits treat it as mere paperwork.

units.zh: 卿等不留心，甚不稱委任之意。」
units.en: Your inattention falls far short of what I entrusted to you."
units.literal: You do not give it your attention—this greatly fails the intent of my commission."

units.zh: 六年八月，敕有司，秋成之後，可于諸路廣糴，以備水旱。
units.en: In the eighth month of year six an edict ordered broad post-harvest purchases on every circuit against flood and drought.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year an edict ordered responsible offices that after the autumn harvest, broad purchase might be made on all circuits to prepare for flood and drought.

units.zh: 九年正月，諭宰臣曰：「朕觀宋人虛誕，恐不能久遵誓約。
units.en: In the first month of year nine he warned his ministers, "The Song are unreliable; they may not keep the treaty for long.
units.literal: In the first month of the ninth year he instructed his ministers: "I observe the Song are empty and deceitful; I fear they cannot long keep their sworn treaty.

units.zh: 其令將臣謹飭邊備，以戒不虞。
units.en: Order frontier commanders to tighten defenses against surprise attack.
units.literal: Let generals and ministers strictly ready border defenses to guard against the unexpected.

units.zh: 去歲河南豐，宜令所在廣糴，以實倉稟。
units.en: Henan had a bumper harvest last year; every locality should buy grain widely and fill the granaries.
units.literal: Last year Henan was abundant; each place should be ordered to purchase broadly and fill the granaries.

units.zh: 詔州縣和糴，毋得抑配百姓。」
units.en: An edict forbade counties and prefectures from coercing the populace during government grain purchases."
units.literal: An edict declared that counties and prefectures conducting harmonized purchase must not forcibly apportion burdens on the people."

units.zh: 十二年
units.en: In the twelfth year
units.literal: In the twelfth year

units.zh: 十二月，詔在都和糴以實倉廩，且使錢幣通流。
units.en: In the twelfth month an edict ordered capital grain purchases to fill granaries and keep currency circulating.
units.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered harmonized purchase in the capital to fill granaries and also circulate currency.

units.zh: 又詔凡秋熟之郡，廣糴以備水旱。
units.en: Another edict required every district with a good harvest to buy grain broadly against disaster.
units.literal: Another edict declared that wherever the autumn harvest was good, broad purchase should prepare against flood and drought.

units.zh: 十六年五月，諭左丞相紇石烈良弼曰：「西邊自來不備儲蓄，其令所在和糴，以備緩急。」
units.en: In the fifth month of year sixteen he told Left Chancellor Heshenilie Liangbi, "The west has never stockpiled grain; order local purchases for emergencies."
units.literal: In the fifth month of the sixteenth year he instructed Left Chancellor Heshenilie Liangbi: "The western frontier has never prepared reserves; order harmonized purchase in each place to prepare for emergencies."

units.zh: 十七年春，尚書省奏：「先奉詔賑濟東京等路饑民，三路粟數不能給。」
units.en: In the spring of year seventeen the Department reported, "Earlier we received an edict to relieve famine victims in the Eastern Capital and other circuits, but the grain of the three circuits cannot meet the need."
units.literal: In the spring of year seventeen the Department reported, "Earlier we received an edict to relieve famine victims in the Eastern Capital and other circuits, but the grain of the three circuits cannot meet the need."

units.zh: 上曰：「朕嘗諭卿等，豐年廣糴以備凶歉。
units.en: The emperor said, "I told you to buy grain generously in good years against famine.
units.literal: The emperor said: "I once instructed you to purchase broadly in abundant years to prepare for lean years.

units.zh: 卿等皆言天下倉廩盈溢，今欲賑濟，乃雲不給。
units.en: You all claimed granaries were overflowing; now you say there is nothing left for relief.
units.literal: You all said the empire's granaries overflowed; now when relief is wanted, you say there is not enough.

units.zh: 自古帝王皆以蓄積為國長計，朕之積粟豈欲獨用。
units.en: Emperors since antiquity stored grain as a long-term policy. I did not stockpile it for myself alone.
units.literal: From antiquity emperors and kings all took accumulation as the state's long-term plan—do I hoard grain to use it alone?

units.zh: 即今不給，可於鄰道取之。
units.en: If supplies run short now, draw from neighboring circuits.
units.literal: If now it is not enough, take it from neighboring circuits.

units.zh: 自今多備，當以為常。」
units.en: Stockpile heavily from now on and make that the norm."
units.literal: From now on prepare abundantly and make it the regular practice."

units.zh: 四月，尚書省奏：「東京三路十二猛安尤闕食者，已賑之矣。
units.en: In the fourth month the Department reported, "The neediest among the twelve meng'an in the three Eastern Capital circuits have already been relieved.
units.literal: In the fourth month the Department reported, "The neediest among the twelve meng'an in the three Eastern Capital circuits have already been relieved.

units.zh: 尚有未賑者。」
units.en: There are still others who have not yet received relief."
units.literal: There are still others who have not yet received relief."

units.zh: 詔遣官詣複州、曷蘇館路，檢視富家，蓄積有餘增直以糴。
units.en: Officials were sent to Fuzhou and the Hesuguan circuit to inspect wealthy households and buy surplus grain at premium prices.
units.literal: An edict dispatched officials to Fuzhou and the Hesuguan circuit to inspect wealthy households; where accumulations were surplus, purchase at raised prices.

units.zh: 令近地居民就往受糧。
units.en: Nearby residents were to collect the grain on site.
units.literal: Nearby residents were ordered to go and receive grain.

units.zh: 十八年四月，命泰州所管諸猛安、西北路招討司所管奚猛安，咸平府慶雲縣寔松河等處遇豐年，多和糴。
units.en: In the fourth month of year eighteen the court ordered meng'an under Taizhou and the Xi under the Northwestern Pacification Commission, and places such as Shisong River in Qingyun County, Xianping Prefecture, to buy grain heavily in good harvest years.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the eighteenth year orders were issued that all meng'an under Taizhou, Xi meng'an under the Northwestern Pacification Commission, and places such as Shisong River in Qingyun County, Xianping Prefecture, when harvests were abundant, conduct extensive harmonized purchase.

units.zh: 章宗明昌四年七月，諭旨戶部官：「聞通州米粟甚賤，若以平價官糴之，何如？」
units.en: In the seventh month of Zhangzong's Mingchang 4 (1193), the emperor instructed Revenue officials, "I hear that rice and grain in Tongzhou are very cheap. What if the government buys them at fair price?"
units.literal: In the seventh month of Zhangzong's Mingchang 4 (1193), the emperor instructed Revenue officials, "I hear that rice and grain in Tongzhou are very cheap. What if the government buys them at fair price?"

units.zh: 於是，有司奏：「中都路去歲不熟，今其價稍減者，以商旅運販繼至故也。
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized, "The Central Capital circuit had a poor harvest last year; if prices have now fallen somewhat, it is because merchant caravans have continued to arrive.
units.literal: The responsible offices memorialized, "The Central Capital circuit had a poor harvest last year; if prices have now fallen somewhat, it is because merchant caravans have continued to arrive.

units.zh: 若即差官爭糴，切恐市價騰踴，貧民愈病，請俟秋收日，依常平倉條理收糴。」
units.en: If officials are immediately sent to compete in buying, we fear market prices will surge and the poor will suffer still more. We ask to wait until the autumn harvest and buy according to the ever-normal granary regulations."
units.literal: If officials are immediately sent to compete in buying, we fear market prices will surge and the poor will suffer still more. We ask to wait until the autumn harvest and buy according to the ever-normal granary regulations."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the delay.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 明昌五年五月，上曰：「聞米價騰踴，今官運至者有餘，可減直以糶之。
units.en: In the fifth month of Mingchang 5 (1194) the emperor said, "Rice prices are soaring, but state shipments have created a surplus—sell grain at reduced prices.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Mingchang 5 the emperor said: "I hear rice prices are soaring; now what the government has transported in is surplus—reduce the price and sell it out.

units.zh: 其明告民，不須貴價私糴也。」
units.en: Tell the people plainly they need not pay private merchants inflated prices."
units.literal: Let this be clearly announced to the people so they need not buy privately at high prices."

units.zh: 六年七月，敕宰臣曰：「詔制內饑謹之地令減價糶之，而貧民無錢者何以得食，其議賑濟。」
units.en: In the seventh month of year six he charged his ministers, "Statutes require discounted sales in famine districts, but how will the poor without cash eat? Propose relief measures."
units.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year he charged his ministers: "Within the statutes, famine districts are ordered to sell at reduced price—but how can the poor without money obtain food? Deliberate on relief."

units.zh: 省臣以為：「闕食州縣，一年則當賑貸，二年然後賑濟，如其民實無恆產者，雖應賑貸，亦請賑濟。」
units.en: Provincial ministers held, "Counties short of food should receive loans in the first year and free relief in the second; if their people truly have no fixed property, then even where loans would be appropriate, we ask that free relief be given."
units.literal: Provincial ministers held, "Counties short of food should receive loans in the first year and free relief in the second; if their people truly have no fixed property, then even where loans would be appropriate, we ask that free relief be given."

units.zh: 上遂命間隔饑荒之地，可以辨錢收糴者減價糶之，貧乏無依者賑濟。
units.en: The emperor ordered discounted sales where buyers could pay, and free relief for the destitute without means.
units.literal: The emperor then ordered that in places with intermittent famine, where people could raise money, grain be sold at reduced price, while the poor without support receive relief grants.

units.zh: 宣宗貞祐三年十月，命高汝礪糴于河南諸郡，令民輸挽入京，複命在京諸倉糴民輸之餘粟。
units.en: In the tenth month of Xuanzong's Zhenyou 3 (1215) Gao Ruli was sent to buy grain in Henan and require transport to the capital; capital granaries were also to buy any surplus the people still held.
units.literal: In the tenth month of Zhenyou 3 under Emperor Xuanzong, Gao Rulü was ordered to purchase grain in Henan prefectures and command the people to transport it to the capital; he was also again ordered that capital granaries purchase the people's surplus grain beyond what was delivered.

units.zh: 侍御史黃摑奴申言：「汝礪所糴足給歲支，民既於租賦之外轉挽而來，亦已勞矣！
units.en: Attending Censor Huangguanu protested, "What Gao Ruli has purchased is enough to meet the year's expenses. Since the people have hauled it in addition to rent and taxes, they are already exhausted!
units.literal: Attending Censor Huangguanu protested, "What Gao Ruli has purchased is enough to meet the year's expenses. Since the people have hauled it in addition to rent and taxes, they are already exhausted!

units.zh: 止將其餘以為歸資，而又強取之，可乎？
units.en: They were entitled to keep the remainder as travel costs—how can the state seize it again?
units.literal: They were only to keep the remainder as return for their costs, yet it is forcibly taken again—is this permissible?

units.zh: 且糴此有日矣，而止得二百余石，此何濟也。」
units.en: Moreover, purchases have been going on for days, yet only 200-odd shi have been obtained. What help is this?"
units.literal: Moreover, purchases have been going on for days, yet only 200-odd shi have been obtained. What help is this?"

units.zh: 詔罷之。
units.en: The edict halted the practice.
units.literal: An edict abolished it.

units.zh: 十二月，附近郡縣多糴於京師，穀價騰踴，遂禁其出境。
units.en: In the twelfth month neighboring districts bought heavily in the capital, grain prices soared, and the court barred grain from leaving the region.
units.literal: In the twelfth month nearby counties and prefectures bought heavily in the capital, grain prices soared, and export from the region was therefore forbidden.

units.zh: 四年，河北行省侯摯言：「河北人相食，觀、滄等州斗米銀十餘兩。
units.en: In the fourth year Hebei Branch Secretariat Hou Zhi reported, "People in Hebei are eating one another, and in Guan, Cang, and other prefectures a dou of rice costs more than ten liang of silver.
units.literal: In the fourth year Hebei Branch Secretariat Hou Zhi reported, "People in Hebei are eating one another, and in Guan, Cang, and other prefectures a dou of rice costs more than ten liang of silver.

units.zh: 伏見沿河諸津許販粟北渡，然每石官糴其八，商人無利，誰肯為之。
units.en: River crossings allow grain to be shipped north, yet the state buys eight-tenths of each shi, leaving merchants no profit—who would undertake the trade?
units.literal: I observe that along the river various fords permit grain to be sold and carried north, yet the government purchases eight-tenths of each shi—merchants gain no profit; who would undertake it?

units.zh: 且河朔之民皆陛下赤子，既罹兵革，又坐視其死，臣恐弄兵之徒得以籍口而起也。
units.en: The people north of the river are Your Majesty's children. They have already suffered war, yet we watch them starve. Rebels may seize on this as a pretext to rise.
units.literal: Moreover the people north of the river are all Your Majesty's children; they have already suffered war, yet we sit and watch them die—I fear those who play with arms will gain a pretext to rise.

units.zh: 願止其糴，縱民輸販為便。」
units.en: I ask that purchases be stopped and that the people be allowed to transport and sell grain freely, which would be convenient."
units.literal: I ask that purchases be stopped and that the people be allowed to transport and sell grain freely, which would be convenient."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the proposal.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 又制凡軍民客旅粟不於官糴處糶，而私販渡河者，杖百。
units.en: Regulations also imposed one hundred blows on soldiers, civilians, or travelers who sold grain privately across the river rather than at official purchase stations.
units.literal: Regulations were also set that whenever soldiers, civilians, or travelers sold grain not at government purchase stations but privately ferried it across the river, they received one hundred blows with the staff.

units.zh: 沿河軍及譏察權豪家犯者，徒年、杖數並的決從重，以物沒官。
units.en: River troops, inspection officers, and powerful families who violated faced on-the-spot sentencing with added severity, and their goods were confiscated.
units.literal: For riverine troops and inspection officers, powerful families who violated—the years of penal servitude and staff blows were all decided on the spot with added severity, and goods were confiscated to the state.

units.zh: 上以河北州府錢多，其散失民間頗廣，命尚書省措畫之。
units.en: Because Hebei held much currency widely dispersed among the populace, the emperor ordered the Department of State Affairs to devise remedies.
units.literal: The emperor, because Hebei prefectures and circuits had much currency widely dispersed among the people, ordered the Department of State Affairs to devise measures.

units.zh: 省臣奏：「已命山東、河北榷酤及濱、滄鹽司，以分數帶納矣。
units.en: Provincial ministers reported, "Shandong and Hebei wine monopolies and the Bin and Cang Salt Offices have already been ordered to accept payment in kind by fractional amounts.
units.literal: Provincial ministers reported, "Shandong and Hebei wine monopolies and the Bin and Cang Salt Offices have already been ordered to accept payment in kind by fractional amounts.

units.zh: 今河北艱食，販粟北渡者眾，宜權立法以遮糴之。
units.en: With Hebei in famine and many shipping grain north, they proposed provisional rules to block state purchases.
units.literal: Now Hebei suffers food shortage and many sell grain and ferry it north; it is fitting to enact provisional law to block purchase.

units.zh: 擬于諸渡口南岸，選通練財貨官，先以金銀絲絹等博易商販之糧，轉之北岸，以回易糴本，兼收見錢。
units.en: They proposed posting skilled finance officials on the south bank of each crossing to trade gold, silver, silk, and satin for merchants' grain, move it north, fund purchases from the proceeds, and collect cash.
units.literal: It was proposed that on the south bank of each crossing skilled finance officials be selected to exchange gold, silver, silk, and satin for merchants' grain, transfer it to the north bank, use the returns to fund purchase capital, and also collect cash.

units.zh: 不惟杜奸弊，亦使錢入京師。」
units.en: This would not only prevent abuses, but also bring currency into the capital."
units.literal: This would not only prevent abuses, but also bring currency into the capital."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 又上封事者曰：「比年以來屢艱食，雖由調度征斂之繁，亦兼併之家有以奪之也。
units.en: Another sealed memorialist said, "In recent years food has repeatedly been scarce. Although this is due to the burden of requisitions and levies, it is also because annexing households have seized supplies.
units.literal: Another sealed memorialist said, "In recent years food has repeatedly been scarce. Although this is due to the burden of requisitions and levies, it is also because annexing households have seized supplies.

units.zh: 收則乘賤多糴，困急則以貸人，私立券質，名為無利而實數倍。
units.en: At harvest they bought cheaply in bulk; in distress they lent on private pledges advertised as interest-free but yielding several times the principal.
units.literal: At harvest they buy heavily when prices are low; when people are desperate they lend, privately setting pledges and bonds—called interest-free but in fact several times over.

units.zh: 饑民惟恐不得，莫敢較者，故場功甫畢，官租未了，而囤已空矣！
units.en: Starving peasants dared not bargain, so threshing had barely ended and official rent was still unpaid when their bins stood empty.
units.literal: Starving people feared only that they could not obtain loans and dared not dispute terms; thus as soon as threshing ended, before official rent was paid, the granaries were already empty!

units.zh: 此富者益富，而貧者益貧者也。
units.en: Thus the rich grew richer and the poor poorer.
units.literal: This is how the rich grow richer and the poor grow poorer.

units.zh: 國朝立法，舉財物者月利不過三分，積久至倍則止，今或不期月而息三倍。
units.en: Dynasty law capped monthly interest at three percent and stopped accumulation at double the principal, yet lenders now sometimes triple interest within a month.
units.literal: Our dynasty's law sets monthly interest on loans at no more than three percent, and when accumulated over time it reaches double it stops—now sometimes within a month interest is triple.

units.zh: 願明敕有司，舉行舊法，豐熟之日增價和糴，則在公有益，而私無損矣。」
units.en: I ask that a clear edict be sent to the responsible offices to implement the old law: in abundant harvest years, raise the price for government purchases. Then the public will benefit and private households will not suffer loss."
units.literal: I ask that a clear edict be sent to the responsible offices to implement the old law: in abundant harvest years, raise the price for government purchases. Then the public will benefit and private households will not suffer loss."

units.zh: 詔宰臣行之。
units.en: The edict ordered chief ministers to implement the policy.
units.literal: An edict ordered the chief ministers to carry it out.

units.zh: 是年，權河東南路宣撫副使烏古論慶壽言邀糴事。
units.en: That year Acting Vice Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Qingshou of the Hedong South Circuit addressed compulsory grain purchases.
units.literal: That year Acting Vice Commissioner of the Hedong South Circuit Pacification Commission Wugulun Qingshou spoke on compulsory purchase matters.

units.zh: 見《鹽志》下。
units.en: See the Salt Treatise, Part 2.
units.literal: See the Salt Treatise, Part 2.

units.zh: 興定元年，上頗聞百姓以和糴太重，棄業者多，命宰臣加意焉。
units.en: In Xingding 1 (1217) the emperor heard that heavy government grain purchases drove many to abandon their trades and ordered chief ministers to address the problem.
units.literal: In the first year of Xingding the emperor heard much that because harmonized purchase was too heavy many people abandoned their occupations, and ordered chief ministers to pay special attention.

units.zh: 八月，以戶部郎中楊貞權陝西行六部尚書，收給潼、陝軍馬之用，奏糴販糧濟河者之半，以寬民。
units.en: In the eighth month Revenue Director Yang Zhen was named acting Shaanxi Six Ministries Chancellor to fund Tong and Shaan cavalry and proposed buying only half the grain merchants sold across the river to ease the burden on the people.
units.literal: In the eighth month Revenue Section Director Yang Zhen was appointed acting Shaanxi Branch Six Ministries Chancellor to collect supplies for Tong and Shaan army horses; he memorialized to purchase only half the grain merchants sold to relieve the Yellow River region, to ease the people.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 六月，立和糴賞格。
units.en: In the sixth month the court established reward standards for government grain purchases.
units.literal: In the sixth month reward standards for harmonized purchase were established.

units.zh: 常平倉
units.en: Ever-Normal Granaries
units.literal: Ever-Normal Granaries

units.zh: 世宗大定十四年，嘗定制，詔中外行之，其法尋廢。
units.en: In Shizong's Dading 14 (1174) regulations were enacted empire-wide, but the system was soon abandoned.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Dading under Emperor Shizong regulations were once fixed and an edict ordered them carried out within and without the court; the method was soon abandoned.

units.zh: 章宗明昌元年八月，御史請複設，敕省臣詳議以聞。
units.en: In the eighth month of Zhangzong's Mingchang 1 (1190) censors asked to restore the system; the court ordered provincial ministers to deliberate and report.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Mingchang 1 under Emperor Zhangzong censors requested restoration; an edict ordered provincial ministers to deliberate in detail and report.

units.zh: 省臣言：「大定舊制，豐年則增市價十之二以糴，儉歲則減市價十之一以出，平歲則已。
units.en: Provincial ministers said, "Under the old Dading system, in abundant years grain was bought at two-tenths above market price; in lean years it was sold at one-tenth below market price; in normal years nothing was done.
units.literal: Provincial ministers said, "Under the old Dading system, in abundant years grain was bought at two-tenths above market price; in lean years it was sold at one-tenth below market price; in normal years nothing was done.

units.zh: 夫所以豐則增價以收者，恐物賤傷農。
units.en: Prices were raised in good years lest cheap grain harm farmers.
units.literal: The reason for raising price to buy in abundance is fear that cheap goods harm farmers.

units.zh: 儉則減價以出者，恐物貴傷民。
units.en: Prices were lowered in scarcity lest dear grain harm the people.
units.literal: In scarcity price is reduced to sell out, fearing that dear goods harm the people.

units.zh: 增之損之以平粟價，故謂常平，非謂使天下之民專仰給於此也。
units.en: Raising and lowering prices stabilized grain markets—hence the name ever-normal—not a plan to make the entire populace depend on these granaries alone.
units.literal: Raising and lowering to level grain prices is therefore called ever-normal—not meaning to make all people under heaven rely solely on this for sustenance.

units.zh: 今天下生齒至眾，如欲計口使餘一年之儲，則不惟數多難辦，又慮出不以時而致腐敗也。
units.en: With the empire's vast population, storing a full year's grain per capita would be unmanageable and risk spoilage if not released in time.
units.literal: Now the population under heaven is extremely numerous; if one wished to calculate by mouth and leave a year's reserve for each, not only would the quantity be hard to manage, but one also fears that if not released in time it would rot.

units.zh: 況複有司抑配之弊，殊非經久之計。
units.en: Forced apportionment by local officials made the scheme unsustainable.
units.literal: Moreover there is the abuse of offices forcibly apportioning burdens—this is truly no long-term plan.

units.zh: 如計諸郡縣驗戶口例以月支三鬥為率，每口但儲三月，已及千萬數，亦足以平物價救荒凶矣。
units.en: If each county stored three months' grain per capita at the standard three-dou monthly ration, totals would reach tens of millions of shi—enough to stabilize prices and relieve famine.
units.literal: If one calculates by counties and prefectures verifying household registers at the rate of three dou monthly ration per person, storing only three months per mouth, the total already reaches tens of millions—this too suffices to level prices and relieve famine and disaster.

units.zh: 若令諸處，自官兵三年食外，可充三月之食者免糴，其不及者俟豐年糴之，庶可久行也。
units.en: Districts with three months' surplus beyond troop rations should be exempt from purchase; deficient districts should buy in good years—then the system could endure.
units.literal: If each place, apart from three years' food for troops and officials, is exempt from purchase where three months' food can be filled, and where it falls short waits for abundant years to purchase, it may perhaps be carried on long.

units.zh: 然立法之始貴在必行，其令提刑司各路計司兼領之，郡縣吏沮格者糾，能推行者加擢用。
units.en: Effective enforcement was essential: the surveillance commission and circuit accounting offices should jointly oversee the system, obstructing clerks impeached and successful implementers promoted.
units.literal: Yet at the beginning of legislation what is valued is certain enforcement: order the surveillance commission and circuit accounting offices jointly to oversee it; county and prefecture clerks who obstruct are to be impeached, those who can implement are to be promoted.

units.zh: 若中都路年穀不熟之所，則依常平法，減其價三之一以糴。」
units.en: Wherever the Central Capital circuit has a poor harvest, buy grain at one-third below market price according to the ever-normal granary method."
units.literal: Wherever the Central Capital circuit has a poor harvest, buy grain at one-third below market price according to the ever-normal granary method."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the plan.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 三年八月，敕：「常平倉豐糴儉糶，有司奉行勤惰褒罰之制，其遍諭諸路，其奉行滅裂者，提刑司糾察以聞。」
units.en: In the eighth month of year three an edict stated, "Ever-normal granaries are to buy in abundant years and sell in lean years. Announce to all circuits the system of rewards and punishments for diligent or lax enforcement; where enforcement is careless, the surveillance commission is to investigate and report."
units.literal: In the eighth month of year three an edict stated, "Ever-normal granaries are to buy in abundant years and sell in lean years. Announce to all circuits the system of rewards and punishments for diligent or lax enforcement; where enforcement is careless, the surveillance commission is to investigate and report."

units.zh: 又謂宰臣曰：「隨處常平倉，往往有名無實。
units.en: He also told his ministers, "Ever-normal granaries everywhere often have the name but not the substance.
units.literal: He also told his ministers, "Ever-normal granaries everywhere often have the name but not the substance.

units.zh: 況遠縣人戶豈肯跋涉，直就州府糶糴。
units.en: Remote county households would not travel to prefectural seats to buy or sell grain.
units.literal: Moreover how would distant county households be willing to travel far and go straight to the prefecture to buy or sell?

units.zh: 可各縣置倉，命州府縣官兼提控管勾。」
units.en: Each county may establish a granary, and prefectural and county officials shall concurrently supervise and manage it."
units.literal: Each county may establish a granary, and prefectural and county officials shall concurrently supervise and manage it."

units.zh: 遂定制，縣距州六十裏內就州倉，六十裏外則特置。
units.en: Counties within sixty li of the prefectural seat used the prefectural granary; those beyond sixty li had their own.
units.literal: Regulations were then fixed: counties within sixty li of the prefectural seat used the prefectural granary; beyond sixty li a separate one was established.

units.zh: 舊擬備戶口三月之糧，恐數多致損，改令戶二萬以上備三萬石，一萬以上備二萬石，一萬以下、五千以上備萬五千石，五千戶以下備五千石。
units.en: The original plan to store three months' grain by household register risked spoilage from large quantities and was replaced by tiered quotas: 30,000 shi for counties above 20,000 households, 20,000 for above 10,000, 15,000 for 5,000–10,000, and 5,000 for below 5,000.
units.literal: Originally it was planned to store three months' grain per household register, fearing large quantities would spoil; it was changed to command households above 20,000 to store 30,000 shi, above 10,000 to store 20,000 shi, below 10,000 but above 5,000 to store 15,000 shi, and below 5,000 households to store 5,000 shi.

units.zh: 河南、陝西屯軍貯糧之縣，不在是數。
units.en: Counties in Henan and Shaanxi that already stored garrison grain were exempt.
units.literal: Counties in Henan and Shaanxi where garrison troops stored grain were not included in these figures.

units.zh: 州縣有倉仍舊，否則創置。
units.en: Existing county granaries were retained; others were newly built.
units.literal: Where prefectures and counties already had granaries they remained; otherwise new ones were created.

units.zh: 郡縣吏受代，所糴粟無壞，一月內交割給由。
units.en: Outgoing county officials had one month to certify and hand over purchased grain in good condition.
units.literal: When prefectural and county clerks were relieved, purchased grain without spoilage was to be handed over with certification within one month.

units.zh: 如無同管勾，亦准上交割。
units.en: Where no co-supervisor existed, the same handover rules applied.
units.literal: If there was no co-supervisor, handover as above was still permitted.

units.zh: 違 限，委州府並提刑司差官催督監交。
units.en: Missed deadlines were referred to prefectures and the surveillance commission to dispatch overseers for supervised handover.
units.literal: Those who violated the deadline were entrusted to prefectures and the surveillance commission to dispatch officials to urge, supervise, and witness handover.

units.zh: 本處歲豐，而收糴不及一分者，本等內降，提刑司體察，直申尚書省，至日斟酌黜陟。
units.en: Officials who bought less than one-tenth of quota in a good year were demoted within grade; the surveillance commission investigated and reported to the Department for evaluation.
units.literal: Where the locality had an abundant year yet purchases did not reach one-tenth, rank was lowered within the grade; the surveillance commission investigated and reported directly to the Department of State Affairs, and at the evaluation date promotion and demotion were weighed.

units.zh: 九月，敕置常平倉之地，令州府官提舉之，縣官兼董其事，以所糴多寡約量升降，為永制。
units.en: In the ninth month an edict made prefectural officials responsible for ever-normal granaries with county officials assisting, tying promotion to purchase volume as permanent policy.
units.literal: In the ninth month an edict ordered that where ever-normal granaries were established, prefectural officials were to direct them and county officials jointly oversee affairs; promotion and demotion were gauged roughly by purchase volume as a permanent rule.

units.zh: 又諭尚書省曰：「上京路諸縣未有常平倉，如亦可置，定其當備粟數以聞。」
units.en: He also instructed the Department of State Affairs, "The counties of the Upper Capital circuit do not yet have ever-normal granaries. If they can be established there too, fix the amount of grain that should be prepared and report it."
units.literal: He also instructed the Department of State Affairs, "The counties of the Upper Capital circuit do not yet have ever-normal granaries. If they can be established there too, fix the amount of grain that should be prepared and report it."

units.zh: 四年十月，尚書省奏：「今上京、蒲與、速頻、曷懶、胡裏改等路，猛安謀克民戶計一十七萬六千有餘，每歲收稅粟二十萬五千余石，所支者六萬六千余石，總其見數二百四十七萬六千余石。
units.en: In the tenth month of year four the Department reported, "The Upper Capital, Puyu, Supin, Helan, Hurigai, and other circuits now have more than 176,000 meng'an and mouke households; each year they collect more than 205,000 shi of tax grain, disburse more than 66,000 shi, and their current total is more than 2,476,000 shi.
units.literal: In the tenth month of year four the Department reported, "The Upper Capital, Puyu, Supin, Helan, Hurigai, and other circuits now have more than 176,000 meng'an and mouke households; each year they collect more than 205,000 shi of tax grain, disburse more than 66,000 shi, and their current total is more than 2,476,000 shi.

units.zh: 臣等以為此地收多支少，遇災足以賑濟，似不必置。」
units.en: We consider that this region collects much and disburses little, and in a disaster it has enough for relief. It seems unnecessary to establish them."
units.literal: We consider that this region collects much and disburses little, and in a disaster it has enough for relief. It seems unnecessary to establish them."

units.zh: 遂止。
units.en: The plan was dropped.
units.literal: It was therefore stopped.

units.zh: 五年九月，尚書省奏：「明昌三年始設常平倉，定其永制。
units.en: In the ninth month of year five the Department reported, "Ever-normal granaries were first established in Mingchang 3, and permanent regulations were fixed.
units.literal: In the ninth month of year five the Department reported, "Ever-normal granaries were first established in Mingchang 3, and permanent regulations were fixed.

units.zh: 天下常平倉總五百一十九處，見積粟三千七百八十六萬三千余石，可備官兵五年之食，米八百一十余萬石，可備四年之用，而見在錢總三千三百四十萬貫有奇，僅支二年以上，見錢既少，且比年稍豐而米價猶貴，若複預糴，恐價騰踴，於民未便。」
units.en: The empire has a total of 519 ever-normal granaries, with more than 37,863,000 shi of stored grain, enough to supply officials and soldiers for five years, and more than 8,100,000 shi of rice, enough for four years; but current cash totals only a little more than 33,400,000 strings, barely enough for more than two years. Since cash is already scarce, and recent years have been somewhat abundant but rice prices are still high, if purchases are again made in advance, prices may surge, which would be inconvenient for the people."
units.literal: The empire has a total of 519 ever-normal granaries, with more than 37,863,000 shi of stored grain, enough to supply officials and soldiers for five years, and more than 8,100,000 shi of rice, enough for four years; but current cash totals only a little more than 33,400,000 strings, barely enough for more than two years. Since cash is already scarce, and recent years have been somewhat abundant but rice prices are still high, if purchases are again made in advance, prices may surge, which would be inconvenient for the people."

units.zh: 遂詔權罷中外常平倉和糴，俟官錢羨餘日舉行。
units.en: An edict provisionally suspended ever-normal purchases empire-wide until official funds were in surplus.
units.literal: An edict then provisionally suspended harmonized purchase at ever-normal granaries within and without the court until official funds were in surplus.

units.zh: 明昌五年閏十月，言事者謂郡縣有河者可開渠，引以溉田，詔下州郡。
units.en: In the intercalary tenth month of Mingchang 5 a memorialist proposed opening canals where rivers existed; the edict was sent to all prefectures.
units.literal: In the intercalary tenth month of Mingchang 5 a memorialist said that counties and prefectures with rivers could open canals to irrigate fields; an edict was sent down to prefectures and districts.

units.zh: 既而八路提 刑司雖有河者皆言不可溉，惟中都言安肅、定興二縣可引河溉田四千餘畝，詔命行之。
units.en: Soon all eight surveillance commissions reported irrigation impossible despite rivers, except the Central Capital, which identified 4,000 mu in Ansu and Dingxing counties; an edict ordered work to proceed.
units.literal: Soon afterward the surveillance commissions of all eight circuits, though rivers existed, all said irrigation was impossible; only the Central Capital reported that Ansu and Dingxing counties could draw river water to irrigate more than 4,000 mu; an edict ordered it carried out.

units.zh: 六年十月，定制，縣官任內有能興水利田及百頃以上者，升本等首注除。
units.en: In the tenth month of year six regulations promised first-rank promotion to county officials who opened 100 qing or more of irrigated land within their term.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year regulations were fixed: county officials who within their term could develop irrigated fields of 100 qing or more were promoted with first notation in their grade.

units.zh: 謀克所管屯田。
units.en: Colony Fields under Mouke Supervision
units.literal: Colony fields under mouke supervision.

units.zh: 能創增三十頃以上，賞銀絹二十兩匹，其租稅止從陸田。
units.en: Those who opened 30 qing or more received twenty liang of silver and bolts of silk, with rent and tax assessed at dry-field rates.
units.literal: Those who could newly add 30 qing or more were rewarded with 20 liang of silver and bolts of silk; their rent and tax followed dry-field rates only.

units.zh: 承安二年，敕放白蓮潭東閘水與百姓溉田。
units.en: In Cheng'an 2 an edict released water from the eastern sluice of White Lotus Pool for irrigation.
units.literal: In Cheng'an 2 an edict released water from the eastern sluice of White Lotus Pool for the people to irrigate fields.

units.zh: 三年，又命勿毀高梁河閘，從民灌溉。
units.en: In the third year the court again forbade destroying the Gaoliang River sluice and allowed public irrigation.
units.literal: In the third year orders were again issued not to destroy the Gaoliang River sluice and to let the people irrigate.

units.zh: 泰和八年七月，詔諸路按察司規畫水田，部官謂：「水田之利甚大，沿河通作渠，如平陽掘井種田俱可灌溉。
units.en: In the seventh month of Taihe 8, the court ordered every circuit surveillance commission to plan paddy fields. A ministry official said, "The benefits of paddy fields are very great. Along rivers, canals can be opened; as at Pingyang, wells can be dug and fields planted, and all can be irrigated.
units.literal: In the seventh month of Taihe 8, the court ordered every circuit surveillance commission to plan paddy fields. A ministry official said, "The benefits of paddy fields are very great. Along rivers, canals can be opened; as at Pingyang, wells can be dug and fields planted, and all can be irrigated.

units.zh: 比年邳、沂近河布種豆麥，無水則鑿井灌之，計六百餘頃，比之陸田所收數倍。
units.en: Recently at Pi and Yi near the river, farmers sowed beans and wheat and dug wells when water failed, irrigating over 600 qing at several times dry-field yields.
units.literal: In recent years at Pi and Yi near the river beans and wheat were sown; when there was no water wells were dug to irrigate—totaling more than 600 qing, yielding several times dry-field harvest.

units.zh: 以此較之，它境無不可行者。」
units.en: Judging by this, there is no other region where it cannot be carried out."
units.literal: Judging by this, there is no other region where it cannot be carried out."

units.zh: 遂令轉運司因出計點，就令審察，若諸路按察司因勸農，可按問開河或掘井如何為便，規畫具申，以俟興作。
units.en: The Transport Commission was to inspect during accounting tours; surveillance commissions promoting agriculture should report whether canals or wells were feasible, pending construction.
units.literal: The Transport Commission was then ordered, when making the outgoing accounts, to conduct inspection on the spot; if surveillance commissions of each circuit, in promoting agriculture, could inquire whether opening rivers or digging wells would be convenient, plan in detail and memorialize, to await construction.

units.zh: 貞祐四年八月，言事者程淵言：「碭山諸縣陂湖，水至則畦為稻田，水退種麥，所收倍於陸地。
units.en: In the eighth month of Zhenyou 4, memorialist Cheng Yuan said, "In the lake and embankment lands of Dangshan and other counties, when water arrives the beds become rice fields, and when the water recedes wheat is planted; their yields are double those of dry land.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Zhenyou 4, memorialist Cheng Yuan said, "In the lake and embankment lands of Dangshan and other counties, when water arrives the beds become rice fields, and when the water recedes wheat is planted; their yields are double those of dry land.

units.zh: 宜募人佃之，官取三之一，歲可得十萬石。」
units.en: Tenants should be recruited for them, with the government taking one-third; each year 100,000 shi can be obtained."
units.literal: Tenants should be recruited for them, with the government taking one-third; each year 100,000 shi can be obtained."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the plan.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 興定五年五月，南陽令李國瑞創開水田四百餘頃，詔升職二等，仍錄其最狀遍諭諸道。
units.en: In the fifth month of Xingding 5 Nanyang Magistrate Li Guorui opened over 400 qing of paddy and was promoted two grades; his record was circulated to all circuits.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Xingding 5 Nanyang Magistrate Li Guorui newly opened more than 400 qing of paddy; an edict promoted him two grades and recorded his top achievement to announce throughout all circuits.

units.zh: 十一月，議興水田。
units.en: In the eleventh month the court discussed expanding paddy cultivation.
units.literal: In the eleventh month paddy development was discussed.

units.zh: 省奏：「漢召信臣於南陽灌溉三萬頃。
units.en: The Department memorialized, "In the Han, Shao Xinchen irrigated 30,000 qing at Nanyang.
units.literal: The Department memorialized, "In the Han, Shao Xinchen irrigated 30,000 qing at Nanyang.

units.zh: 魏賈逵堰汝水為新陂，通運二百餘裏，人謂之賈侯渠。
units.en: Under Wei, Jia Kui dammed the Ru River into a new reservoir linking transport for over 200 li, known as Marquis Jia's Canal.
units.literal: Under Wei, Jia Kui dammed the Ru River into a new reservoir, connecting transport for more than 200 li—people called it Marquis Jia's Canal.

units.zh: 鄧艾修淮陽、百尺二渠，通淮、潁、大治諸陂于潁之南，穿渠三百餘裏，溉田二萬頃。
units.en: Deng Ai repaired the Huaiyang and Baichi canals, linking the Huai and Ying and major reservoirs south of the Ying with canals over 300 li long, irrigating 20,000 qing.
units.literal: Deng Ai repaired the Huaiyang and Baichi canals, connecting the Huai, Ying, and great reservoirs south of the Ying, cutting canals more than 300 li and irrigating 20,000 qing of fields.

units.zh: 今河南郡縣多古所開水田之地，收穫多於陸地數倍。」
units.en: Now many prefectures and counties in Henan have ancient paddy-field sites, where the harvest is several times greater than on dry land."
units.literal: Now many prefectures and counties in Henan have ancient paddy-field sites, where the harvest is several times greater than on dry land."

units.zh: 敕令分治戶部按行州郡，有可開者誘民赴功，其租止依陸田，不復添征，仍以官賞激之。
units.en: The Revenue Ministry was to tour prefectures, encourage reclamation where feasible, assess rent at dry-field rates without surcharges, and offer official rewards.
units.literal: An edict ordered the divided Revenue Ministry to tour prefectures and districts; where opening was possible, induce the people to undertake the work; rent follows dry-field rates only without added levies, and still use official rewards to encourage them.

units.zh: 陝西除三白渠設官外，亦宜視例施行。
units.en: Shaanxi, apart from the Sanbai Canal's established officials, should follow the same precedent.
units.literal: In Shaanxi, apart from the Sanbai Canal with its established officials, the precedent should likewise be applied.

units.zh: 元光元年正月，遣戶部郎中楊大有等詣京東、西、南三路開水田。
units.en: In the first month of the first year of Yuanguang Revenue Director Yang Dayou and others were sent to the eastern, western, and southern capital circuits to open paddy.
units.literal: In the first month of Yuanguang 1 Revenue Section Director Yang Dayou and others were dispatched to the eastern, western, and southern capital circuits to open paddy fields.

units.zh: 區田之法
units.en: Method of Plot Farming
units.literal: Method of Plot Farming

units.zh: 見嵇康《養生論》，自是歷代未有天下通用如趙過一畝三甽之法者。
units.en: See Ji Kang's Treatise on Nourishing Life; no method since has been applied empire-wide like Zhao Guo's three-furrow-per-mu system.
units.literal: See Ji Kang's "Treatise on Nourishing Life"; from then on through successive dynasties none was universally applied under heaven like Zhao Guo's method of three furrows per mu.

units.zh: 章宗明昌三年三月，宰執嘗論其法於上前，上曰：「卿等所言甚嘉，但恐農民不達此法。
units.en: In the third month of Zhangzong's Mingchang 3, the chief ministers once discussed the method before the throne. The emperor said, "What you have said is excellent; I only fear that farmers will not understand this method.
units.literal: In the third month of Zhangzong's Mingchang 3, the chief ministers once discussed the method before the throne. The emperor said, "What you have said is excellent; I only fear that farmers will not understand this method.

units.zh: 如其可行，當遍諭之。」
units.en: If it can be carried out, it should be announced everywhere."
units.literal: If it can be carried out, it should be announced everywhere."

units.zh: 四年夏四月，上與宰執複言其法，久之，參知政事胥持國曰：「今日方之大定間，戶口既多，費用亦厚。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, year four, the emperor again discussed the method with the chief ministers. After some time, Vice Director Xu Chiguo said, "Compared with the Dading era, today the population is larger and expenses are also heavier.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, year four, the emperor again discussed the method with the chief ministers. After some time, Vice Director Xu Chiguo said, "Compared with the Dading era, today the population is larger and expenses are also heavier.

units.zh: 若區種之法行，良多利益。」
units.en: If the method of plot planting is carried out, it will bring many benefits."
units.literal: If the method of plot planting is carried out, it will bring many benefits."

units.zh: 上曰：「 此法自古有之，若其可行，則何為不行也？」
units.en: The emperor said, "This method is ancient; if it works, why has it not been adopted?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "This method has existed since antiquity; if it can be carried out, why is it not done?"

units.zh: 持國曰：「所以不行者，蓋民未見其利。
units.en: Chiguo said, "The reason it has not been carried out is probably that the people have not yet seen its benefits.
units.literal: Chiguo said, "The reason it has not been carried out is probably that the people have not yet seen its benefits.

units.zh: 今已令試種于城南之地，乃委官往監督之。
units.en: Trial plots south of the city were already under official supervision.
units.literal: Now trial planting has been ordered on land south of the city, and officials are entrusted to go supervise it.

units.zh: 若使民見收成之利，當不率行者自效矣。」
units.en: If the people are made to see the benefit of the harvest, those who have not been compelled to carry it out will imitate it themselves."
units.literal: If the people are made to see the benefit of the harvest, those who have not been compelled to carry it out will imitate it themselves."

units.zh: 參知政事夾穀衡以為：「若有其利，古已行矣。
units.en: Vice Director Jiagu Heng said, "If it had such benefits, it would already have been practiced in antiquity.
units.literal: Vice Director Jiagu Heng said, "If it had such benefits, it would already have been practiced in antiquity.

units.zh: 且用功多而所種少，複恐廢壟畝之田功也。」
units.en: Moreover, it requires much labor and plants little; I also fear it will waste the work of ordinary ridge fields."
units.literal: Moreover, it requires much labor and plants little; I also fear it will waste the work of ordinary ridge fields."

units.zh: 上曰：「姑試行之。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Try it for now."
units.literal: The emperor said: "For now try carrying it out."

units.zh: 六月，上問參知政事胥持國曰：「區種事如何？」
units.en: In the sixth month the emperor asked Vice Director Xu Chiguo, "How is the matter of plot planting?"
units.literal: In the sixth month the emperor asked Vice Director Xu Chiguo, "How is the matter of plot planting?"

units.zh: 對曰：「六七月之交，方可見矣。」
units.en: He replied, "Only around the sixth and seventh months can it be seen."
units.literal: He replied, "Only around the sixth and seventh months can it be seen."

units.zh: 「河東及代州田種今歲佳否？」
units.en: He also asked, "How are the crops this year in Hedong and Daizhou?"
units.literal: "How are the crops this year in Hedong and Daizhou?"

units.zh: 曰：「比常年頗登。」
units.en: The reply was, "Compared with ordinary years, they are quite abundant."
units.literal: The reply was, "Compared with ordinary years, they are quite abundant."

units.zh: 是日，命近侍二人馳驛巡視京畿禾稼。
units.en: That day two attendants were sent by post horse to inspect the capital region's crops.
units.literal: That day two close attendants were ordered to ride post-horses and inspect the grain crops of the capital region.

units.zh: 五年正月，敕諭農民使區種，先是，陳言人武陟高翌上區種法，且請驗人丁地土多少，定數令種。
units.en: In the first month of year five an edict ordered plot farming; memorialist Gao Yi of Wuzhi had earlier submitted the method and asked to set planting quotas based on household registers and land holdings.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year an edict instructed farmers to use plot farming; earlier, memorialist Gao Yi of Wuzhi submitted the plot-farming method and also requested verifying household registers and land holdings, fixing quotas for planting.

units.zh: 上令尚書省議既定，遂敕令農田百畝以上，如瀕河易得水之地，須區種三十餘畝，多種者聽。
units.en: After the Department finalized rules, farms of 100 mu or more near rivers had to plant at least 30 mu by the plot method, with more permitted.
units.literal: The emperor ordered the Department of State Affairs to deliberate and fix rules; an edict then commanded that for farmland of 100 mu or more, where near rivers water was easily obtained, more than 30 mu must be plot-farmed; planting more was permitted.

units.zh: 無水之地則從民便。
units.en: Waterless land was left to farmers' discretion.
units.literal: Where there was no water, the people's convenience was followed.

units.zh: 仍委各千戶謀克縣官依法勸率。
units.en: Thousand-household mouke and county officials were to encourage compliance.
units.literal: Each thousand-household mouke and county official was still entrusted to encourage and lead according to law.

units.zh: 承安元年四月，初行區種法，男年十五以上、六十以下有土田者丁種一畝，丁多者五畝止。
units.en: In the fourth month of Cheng'an 1 plot farming took effect: males fifteen to sixty with land planted one mu per ding, capped at five mu per household.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Cheng'an 1 plot farming was first implemented: males aged fifteen and above but below sixty with land were to plant one mu per ding; those with many ding stopped at five mu.

units.zh: 二年二月，九路提刑馬百祿奏：「聖訓農民有地一頃者區種一畝，五畝即止。
units.en: In the second month of year two, nine-circuit Surveillance Commissioner Ma Bailu memorialized, "The sacred instruction is that farmers with one qing of land should plant one mu by the plot method, stopping at five mu.
units.literal: In the second month of year two, nine-circuit Surveillance Commissioner Ma Bailu memorialized, "The sacred instruction is that farmers with one qing of land should plant one mu by the plot method, stopping at five mu.

units.zh: 臣以為地肥瘠不同，乞不限畝數。」
units.en: I consider that land differs in fertility and barrenness, and ask that the number of mu not be limited."
units.literal: I consider that land differs in fertility and barrenness, and ask that the number of mu not be limited."

units.zh: 制可。
units.en: The regulation was approved.
units.literal: The regulation was approved.

units.zh: 泰和四年九月，尚書省奏：「近奉旨講議區田，臣等謂此法本欲利民，或以天旱乃始用之，倉卒施功未必有益也。
units.en: In the ninth month of Taihe 4 the Department memorialized, "Recently we received an imperial command to discuss plot farming. We consider that this method was originally intended to benefit the people; if it is first used only during drought, hasty labor may not be beneficial.
units.literal: In the ninth month of Taihe 4 the Department memorialized, "Recently we received an imperial command to discuss plot farming. We consider that this method was originally intended to benefit the people; if it is first used only during drought, hasty labor may not be beneficial.

units.zh: 且五方地肥瘠不同，使皆可以區種，農民見有利自當勉效之。
units.en: Soils differ across the five regions; where plot farming works, farmers seeing profit would adopt it willingly.
units.literal: Moreover the five regions differ in soil fertility; if all may use plot farming, when farmers see profit they will naturally strive to follow.

units.zh: 不然，督責雖嚴，亦徒勞耳。」
units.en: Otherwise, however strict the supervision may be, it will only be wasted labor."
units.literal: Otherwise, however strict the supervision may be, it will only be wasted labor."

units.zh: 敕遂令所在長官及按察司隨宜勸諭，亦竟不能行。
units.en: An edict ordered local chiefs and surveillance commissions to encourage adoption, but the method never took hold.
units.literal: An edict then ordered local chiefs and surveillance commissions to encourage as appropriate, yet in the end it could not be carried out.

units.zh: 入粟鬻度牒
units.en: Submitting Grain and Selling Ordination Certificates
units.literal: Submitting Grain and Selling Ordination Certificates

units.zh: 熙宗皇統三年三月，陝西旱饑，詔許富民入粟補官。
units.en: In the third month of Xizong's Huangtong 3 (1143) drought and famine struck Shaanxi; wealthy households were allowed to buy offices with grain.
units.literal: In the third month of Huangtong 3 under Emperor Xizong, Shaanxi suffered drought and famine; an edict permitted wealthy households to submit grain to supplement offices.

units.zh: 世宗大定元年，以兵興歲歉，下令聽民進納補官。
units.en: In Shizong's Dading 1 (1161) war and crop failure led the court to allow grain payments for offices.
units.literal: In the first year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, because war arose and harvests failed, an order permitted the people to advance payments to supplement offices.

units.zh: 又募能濟饑民者，視其人數為補官格。
units.en: Those who relieved famine victims were also recruited, with office grades set by the number saved.
units.literal: Those able to relieve famine victims were also recruited; according to the number of people saved, office-supplement grades were set.

units.zh: 五年，上謂宰臣曰：「頃以邊事未定，財用闕乏，自東、南兩京外，命民進納補官，及賣僧、道、尼、女冠度牒，紫、褐衣師號，寺觀名額。
units.en: In the fifth year the emperor told his ministers, "Recently, because border affairs were unsettled and finances were short, outside the Eastern and Southern Capitals we ordered the people to submit payments to receive office, and sold ordination certificates for monks, Daoists, nuns, and priestesses, purple and brown robe master titles, and temple and monastery name quotas.
units.literal: In the fifth year the emperor told his ministers, "Recently, because border affairs were unsettled and finances were short, outside the Eastern and Southern Capitals we ordered the people to submit payments to receive office, and sold ordination certificates for monks, Daoists, nuns, and priestesses, purple and brown robe master titles, and temple and monastery name quotas.

units.zh: 今邊鄙已寧，其悉罷之。
units.en: With the frontier now calm, all these measures were abolished.
units.literal: Now the borderlands are calm; let all these be abolished.

units.zh: 慶壽寺、天長觀歲給度牒，每道折錢二十萬以賜之。」
units.en: Qingshou Temple and Tianchang Abbey are given ordination certificates each year, each certificate being converted to 200,000 cash and granted to them."
units.literal: Qingshou Temple and Tianchang Abbey are given ordination certificates each year, each certificate being converted to 200,000 cash and granted to them."

units.zh: 明昌二年，敕山東、河北闕食之地，納粟補官有差。
units.en: In Mingchang 2 graded rates for grain office purchases applied in famine-stricken parts of Shandong and Hebei.
units.literal: In Mingchang 2 an edict ordered that in Shandong and Hebei where food was lacking, grain submission for office supplement had graded rates.

units.zh: 承安二年，賣度牒、師號、寺觀額，複令人入粟補官。
units.en: In Cheng'an 2 the court again sold certificates, master titles, and temple quotas and allowed grain office purchases.
units.literal: In Cheng'an 2 ordination certificates, master titles, and monastery quotas were sold, and people were again permitted to submit grain for office supplement.

units.zh: 三年，西京饑，詔賣度牒以濟之。
units.en: In the third year famine in the Western Capital led the court to sell ordination certificates for relief.
