units.literal: In the third year the Western Capital suffered famine; an edict sold ordination certificates to relieve it.

units.zh: 宣宗貞祐二年，從知大興府事胥鼎所請，定權宜鬻恩例格，進宮升職、丁憂人許應舉求仕、監戶從良之類，入粟草各有數。
units.en: In Xuanzong's Zhenyou 2, on Daxing Prefecture Administrator Xu Ding's request, provisional favor-sale rates were fixed for advancement in palace rank and promotion, permission for those in mourning to take examinations and seek office, manumission of registered households, and similar benefits, each with set grain or fodder payments.
units.literal: In Zhenyou 2 under Emperor Xuanzong, following the request of Daxing Prefecture Administrator Xu Ding, provisional grades for selling favors were fixed: advancement in palace rank, promotion, permission for those in mourning to take examinations and seek office, manumission of registered households, and the like—each with set amounts of grain and fodder submitted.

units.zh: 三年，制無問官民，有能勸率諸人納物入官者，米百五十石遷官一階，正班任使。
units.en: In year three anyone, official or commoner, who induced others to submit goods received one promotion rank and regular appointment for 150 shi of rice.
units.literal: In the third year regulations made no distinction between officials and commoners: whoever could encourage others to submit goods to the government—150 shi of rice meant one rank of promotion and appointment in the regular roster.

units.zh: 七百石兩階，除諸司。
units.en: 700 shi brought two ranks and appointment in various offices.
units.literal: 700 shi meant two ranks and appointment in various offices.

units.zh: 千石三階，除丞簿。
units.en: 1,000 shi brought three ranks and appointment as aide or registrar.
units.literal: 1,000 shi meant three ranks and appointment as aide or registrar.

units.zh: 過此數則請於朝廷議賞。
units.en: Larger contributions required court deliberation on rewards.
units.literal: Beyond these amounts one requested the court to deliberate rewards.

units.zh: 推司縣官有能勸二千石遷一階，三千石兩階，以濟軍儲。
units.en: Investigation and county officials who induced 2,000 shi received one rank and 3,000 shi two ranks, to fill army stores.
units.literal: Investigation-office and county officials who could encourage 2,000 shi received one rank; 3,000 shi two ranks—to supply army stores.

units.zh: 又定制，司縣官能勸率進糧至五千石以上者減一資考，萬石以上遷一官，減二等考，二萬石以上遷一官、升一等，皆注見闕。
units.en: Investigation and county officials who induced 5,000 shi or more had one review grade reduced; 10,000 shi brought one promotion and two grades reduced; 20,000 shi one promotion and one grade raised—all to current vacancies.
units.literal: Further regulations fixed that investigation and county officials who could encourage grain submission of 5,000 shi or more had one seniority review reduced; 10,000 shi or more one office promotion and two review grades reduced; 20,000 shi or more one office promotion and one grade raised—all assigned to current vacancies.

units.zh: 四年，河東行省胥鼎言：「河東兵多民少，倉空歲饑。
units.en: In year four Hedong Branch Secretariat Xu Ding said, "In Hedong troops are many and people few; the granaries are empty and the year is famine-struck.
units.literal: In year four Hedong Branch Secretariat Xu Ding said, "In Hedong troops are many and people few; the granaries are empty and the year is famine-struck.

units.zh: 竊見潞州元帥府雖設鬻爵恩例，然條目至少，未盡勸率之術。
units.en: Although Luzhou Marshal's headquarters had favor-sale rules, the articles were too few to encourage full participation.
units.literal: I observe that although the Luzhou Marshal's headquarters has set favor-sale precedents, the articles are very few and do not exhaust methods of encouragement.

units.zh: 今擬凡補買正班，依格止廕一名。
units.en: Purchased regular-rank posts would grant only one yin privilege by regulation.
units.literal: It is now proposed that for all purchased regular-rank posts, by regulation only one yin privilege is granted.

units.zh: 若願輸許增廕一名。
units.en: Additional payment could buy one more yin privilege.
units.literal: If willing to submit more, one additional yin is permitted.

units.zh: 僧道已具師號者，許補買本司官。
units.en: Monks and Daoists with master titles could purchase posts in their own bureaus.
units.literal: Monks and Daoists who already held master titles were permitted to purchase posts in their own bureaus.

units.zh: 職官願納粟或不願給俸及券糧者，宜量數遷加。
units.en: Officials who submitted grain or waived salary and ration certificates should receive measured promotions.
units.literal: Functional officials willing to submit grain or unwilling to receive salary and ration certificates should be promoted by measured amounts.

units.zh: 三舉終場人年五十以上，四舉年四十五以上，並許入粟，該恩大小官及承應人。
units.en: Exam candidates aged fifty or above after three rounds, or forty-five after four, could buy minor offices or attendant posts with grain.
units.literal: Those who completed three examination rounds aged fifty or above, or four rounds aged forty-five or above, were all permitted grain submission, qualifying for favors as minor officials or attendants.

units.zh: 令譯史吏員，雖未系班，亦許進納遷官。
units.en: Clerks, translators, and scribes not yet on the roster could also buy promotion.
units.literal: Clerks, translators, and scribes, though not yet on the roster, were also permitted to advance payments for promotion.

units.zh: 其有品官應注諸司者，聽獻物借注丞簿。
units.en: Ranked officials awaiting assignment could submit goods for provisional aide or registrar posts.
units.literal: Ranked officials due for assignment to various offices were permitted to submit goods for provisional appointment as aide or registrar.

units.zh: 丞簿注縣令，差使免一差。
units.en: Aides and registrars could advance to county magistrate; one dispatch tour was waived.
units.literal: Aides and registrars could be assigned as county magistrates; dispatch duties were reduced by one tour.

units.zh: 掌軍官能自備芻糧者，依職官例遷官如舊。」
units.en: Commanding officers who can supply their own fodder and grain should be promoted under the former precedent for regular officials."
units.literal: Commanding officers who can supply their own fodder and grain should be promoted under the former precedent for regular officials."

units.zh: 四年，耀州僧廣惠言：「軍儲不足，凡京府節鎮以上僧道官，乞令納粟百石。
units.en: In year four Yaozhou monk Guanghui said, "Army stores are insufficient. For all monastic officials at the capital, prefectural, and military commission level and above, I ask that they be ordered to submit 100 shi of grain.
units.literal: In year four Yaozhou monk Guanghui said, "Army stores are insufficient. For all monastic officials at the capital, prefectural, and military commission level and above, I ask that they be ordered to submit 100 shi of grain.

units.zh: 防刺郡副綱、威儀等，七十石者乃充，三十月滿替。
units.en: Deputy abbots and masters of ceremony in defense prefectures required 70 shi and served thirty-month terms.
units.literal: Deputy abbots and masters of ceremony in defense prefectures required 70 shi to qualify; terms ended at thirty months.

units.zh: 諸監寺十石，周年一代，願複買者聽。」
units.en: Supervisory temples require 10 shi, with one replacement each full year; those who wish to purchase again are permitted."
units.literal: Supervisory temples require 10 shi, with one replacement each full year; those who wish to purchase again are permitted."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the proposal.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 興定元年，潞州行元帥府事粘割貞言：「近承奏格，凡去歲覃恩之官，以品從差等聽其入粟，委帥府書空宣敕授之，則人無陳訴之勞，而官有儲蓄矣。
units.en: In Xingding 1, Niange Zhen, acting head of the Luzhou Marshal Headquarters, said, "Recently we received the submitted regulations: for all offices granted in last year's general amnesty, grain submissions are permitted according to rank and status, and the Marshal Headquarters is entrusted to write blank imperial appointment documents and confer them. Thus people have no burden of petitioning, while the government has reserves.
units.literal: In Xingding 1, Niange Zhen, acting head of the Luzhou Marshal Headquarters, said, "Recently we received the submitted regulations: for all offices granted in last year's general amnesty, grain submissions are permitted according to rank and status, and the Marshal Headquarters is entrusted to write blank imperial appointment documents and confer them. Thus people have no burden of petitioning, while the government has reserves.

units.zh: 比年屢降覃恩，凡羈縻軍職者多未暇授，若止許遷新覃，則將隔越矣。
units.en: In recent years general amnesties have repeatedly been issued, and many who hold loose-rein military posts have not yet had time to receive appointments. If only promotion under the newest amnesty is allowed, earlier cases will be passed over.
units.literal: In recent years general amnesties have repeatedly been issued, and many who hold loose-rein military posts have not yet had time to receive appointments. If only promotion under the newest amnesty is allowed, earlier cases will be passed over.

units.zh: 乞令計前後所該輸粟積遷。」
units.en: I request that the grain due under earlier and later provisions be counted together for cumulative promotion."
units.literal: I request that the grain due under earlier and later provisions be counted together for cumulative promotion."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict approved the proposal.
units.literal: The edict approved the proposal.
